description: Each tracked brand's mentions as a share of every tracked brand's, in the same answers. THE DENOMINATOR IS THE TRACKED SET, NOT THE MARKET: a workspace tracking two competitors and one tracking twelve produce incomparable numbers from identical answers, so always report `brands_counted` beside any share you quote. `share` is null when no brand was named at all, which is undefined rather than zero. RULES: a null rate means NOT ENOUGH ANSWERS YET, never zero — never render it as 0%. Engines are reported separately and must never be averaged into one score.

brand.description: Which brand to report on, from list_brands. REQUIRED when the organisation has more than one brand: omitting it returns brand_required rather than guessing, because a silent default would file one customer's numbers under another's.

name: get_share_of_voice
title: Mention share across the brands this workspace tracks
